summary: Backend-first validation stopped early: first-manager setup fails with 422 using required credential email domain, blocking all authenticated/API integration flows.

critical.issue: Returns 422 for required setup email gestor.validacao@vertice.test (EmailStr rejects reserved/special-use domain). This blocks initial workspace claim and all dependent tests.

minor.issue: Credentials file is effectively empty (template only); no pre-registered accounts listed.
File not found while following auth testing instructions.

integration_issues.flow: First manager onboarding -> authenticated dashboard flows
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by backend setup validation failure (422), so frontend-to-backend authenticated workflows could not be executed.

action_items: Fix /api/auth/setup email validation compatibility with approved test credentials OR update required credentials to RFC-valid non-reserved domain.
After fix, rerun backend regression file and continue full frontend workflow testing.
Provide/restore /app/auth_testing.md if it is required by process.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding dependency risk: strict email validation currently conflicts with approved test credential domain, creating a hard blocker for MVP functional validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run setup with required credentials first. If 422 persists, capture /api/auth/setup response body and backend validation path. Once fixed, execute /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_regression.py then proceed with Playwright end-to-end flows.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: POST /api/auth/setup with required email gestor.validacao@vertice.test returns 422 with message that domain after @ is special-use/reserved. Root cause: backend schema uses strict EmailStr validation that rejects reserved test domains. Mitigation: use accepted non-reserved domain for required credentials or relax validation policy specifically for controlled test domains.
